article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 15 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Radio City Playhouse, The Bickersons, and Jackie Robinson
article-meta.kwd-group: Radio City Playhouse, The Bickersons, Don Ameche, Frances Langford, Jackie Robinson, NBC Radio, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 14 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 14 resolves 15 landmark radio broadcasts across three classic properties: Harry W. Junkin's acclaimed NBC dramatic anthology ***Radio City Playhouse*** (1948–1949 master attraction runs), Philip Rapp's legendary comedy series ***The Bickersons*** (starring Don Ameche, Frances Langford, and Danny Thomas), and rare 1959 syndicated sports interviews hosted by baseball Hall of Famer ***Jackie Robinson***.

sec.title: 2. *The Bickersons* — Don Ameche & Frances Langford NBC Comedy Classics
sec.p: Philip Rapp's masterpiece of marital sparring, featuring Danny Thomas as Brother Amos:
